title: cochlearia officinalis subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Cochlearia officinalis subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean Rock Cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pyrenean Rock Cress include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to relieve symptoms of urinary tract infections and edema. Its bioactive constituents include glucosinolates and other sulfur-containing compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
